newsitem.title: USA: Ziff-Davis launches PC Week China.
newsitem.headline: Ziff-Davis launches PC Week China.

text.p: Ziff-Davis International Media Group said Friday it launched PC Week China.

The weekly trade publication will be sent free to volume buyers of computer products for organizations. It will be the first publication to use a controlled circulation strategy and the first to be published in full color in China, Ziff-Davis said.
Ziff-Davis is owned by Softbank Corp of Japan.
PC Week China is the third Ziff-Davis title to be launched in the Chinese market after PC Magazine China and PC Computing China, the company said.
PC Week China will be published under license from Ziff-Davis Richina Media LDC to the Chinese Institute of Electronics. The first issue will debut on September 23, with a circulation of 60,000.
